tables.name: public.bills
tables.comment: 議案の基本情報を格納するテーブル。コンテンツはbill_contentsテーブルで管理。

columns.name: published_at
columns.comment: サービスでの議案公開日時

columns.name: thumbnail_url
columns.comment: URL to the bill thumbnail image stored in Supabase Storage

columns.name: is_featured
columns.comment: Flag to indicate if this bill is featured on the homepage

columns.name: publish_status_order
columns.extra_def:
GENERATED ALWAYS AS 
CASE publish_status
    WHEN 'draft'::bill_publish_status THEN 0
    WHEN 'coming_soon'::bill_publish_status THEN 1
    WHEN 'published'::bill_publish_status THEN 2
    ELSE NULL::integer
END STORED
columns.comment: 公開状態ソート順(draft → coming_soon → published の順。Generated Column)

columns.name: bill_number
columns.comment: 議案番号（例: 「第1号」「報告第1号」など）。空文字は未設定を示す。

columns.name: status_order
columns.extra_def:
GENERATED ALWAYS AS 
CASE status
    WHEN 'approved'::bill_status_enum THEN 0
    WHEN 'adopted'::bill_status_enum THEN 0
    WHEN 'reported'::bill_status_enum THEN 0
    WHEN 'partially_adopted'::bill_status_enum THEN 1
    WHEN 'rejected'::bill_status_enum THEN 2
    WHEN 'plenary_session'::bill_status_enum THEN 3
    WHEN 'in_committee'::bill_status_enum THEN 4
    WHEN 'submitted'::bill_status_enum THEN 5
    WHEN 'preparing'::bill_status_enum THEN 6
    ELSE NULL::integer
END STORED

columns.name: bill_type
columns.comment: 議案種別(bill:通常議案 / bill_settlement:決算認定 / bill_personnel:人事同意 / bill_ratification:専決処分承認 / consultation:諮問 / opinion:意見書案 / petition:請願 / appeal:陳情 / report:報告 / resolution:決議 / member_bill:議員提出議案)

columns.extra_def:

    ELSE NULL::integer
END STORED
